  gallery["make docs<br/>doc copies + model pages + Quarto"]
  pages["GitHub Pages<br/>the gallery and its 3D viewer"]
  railparts["the grow-light rail's five parts<br/>Phase 2"]

  gauges["two dowel gauges for the store:<br/>a taper card and a hole grid<br/>Phase 2"]

  design --> build --> built
  built --> ci
  design --> ci
  built --> gallery
